derivability.boundary: fillCreationHoles rejected result and discoverCreationHoles projection
fillCreationHoles rejected result and finalizeCharacterDraft projection

derivability.sourceField: submitted CreationFill batch, current CharacterDraft.revision, and currently derived Creation Hole Frontier

notes: Character Draft owns accepted source facts and draft revision.
Creation Hole Frontier is derived by discoverCreationHoles from the draft and support-profile readers; no durable open-hole ledger is stored.
Finalization is derived by finalizeCharacterDraft from the draft and support-profile admission; no durable finalization status ledger is stored beside the draft.
Rejected batch issues and fill issues are result projections at the fillCreationHoles boundary, not durable state beside the draft.
Closed and not-yet-open holes are rejected by comparing a fill against the derived Creation Hole Frontier; no closed-hole status field is stored.
Character Build is produced only by the finalization gate once holes are empty and the support profile admits the completed draft.
